ourPartners.heading: Our Partners
ourPartners.text: The organisations and venues behind our conferences, delegations and exchanges. Interested in partnering with LDII? Write to us at admin@ldiinitiatives.org.

donateSection.heading: Support Our Mission
donateSection.text: Your generous donations help us create lasting impact in communities worldwide. Every contribution makes a difference.
donateSection.text2: Make a single contribution to support our programs and initiatives. Your donation directly funds projects that build resilience and empower communities.
donateSection.label: Support immediate community needs
donateSection.label3: We confirm every gift by email
donateSection.text3: Become a sustaining donor with monthly contributions. Your ongoing support provides stable funding for long-term programs and sustainable impact.
donateSection.label6: A yearly summary of your giving

volunteerSection.heading: Volunteer With Us
volunteerSection.text: Join our team of dedicated volunteers making a difference in communities worldwide. Your time and skills can create lasting impact.
volunteerSection.text2: Assist with program delivery, event coordination, and community outreach activities.
volunteerSection.text3: Share your expertise in areas like research, communications, design, or technology.
volunteerSection.text4: Contribute from anywhere with virtual volunteering in research, writing, or advocacy.
volunteerSection.placeholder: Tell us about your skills, experience, and why you want to volunteer with LDII (max 500 characters)

ctaSection.heading: Join Our Global Network
ctaSection.text: Whether through partnership, donation, or volunteering, there are many ways to support our mission of building global resilience.
